newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam Jan-May trade gap at $1,135.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam Jan-May trade gap at $1,135.9 mln.

text.p: Vietnam recorded a trade deficit of $1,135.9 million in the first five months of this year and the trade gap in May was an estimated $230 million, Vietnam General Statistics Office figures showed on Wednesday.
The statistics office estimated exports in May at $720 million and put imports during the month at $950 million.
It said that exports rose 31.8 percent in the first five months of 1997 and imports increased 1.5 percent from the same period a year earlier.
The deficit in the first four months of this year had been put at $962 million.
Vietnam recorded a trade deficit of $4 billion in 1996.
